# Rhetorical rhythm fixture

The built CLI reports complete related clauses for repeated negative-to-positive
reframing, embedded document self-description, an abstract recasting contrast,
and an information-subject aphorism. BOM, CRLF, Unicode, bold text, and protected
operands exercise source coordinates in JSON and SARIF. Literal maps, qualified
evidence, concrete alternatives, ordinary semicolons, and quoted code are controls.

The fixture tests bounded recognition and transport. It is not a corpus precision,
recall, or authorship measurement.
